description:
The process of Vacations Request starts when any employee of the organization submits a vacation request.
Once the requirement is registered, the request is received by the immediate supervisor of the employee requesting the vacation.
The supervisor must approve or reject the request.
If the request is rejected, the application is returned to the applicant / employee who can review the rejection reasons.
If the request is approved a notification is generated to the Human Resources Representative, who must complete the respective management procedures.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_VacationRequest" name="Vacation request process starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit vacation request">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive request (immediate supervisor)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveOrReject" name="Approve or reject request (supervisor)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_Outcome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestOutcome" name="Request approved?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_Outcome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" name="Return rejected request to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_ReviewReasons</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review rejection reasons (employee)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_ReviewReasons</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewReasons_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectionReviewed" name="Rejection reasons reviewed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewReasons_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateNotification" name="Generate notification to Human Resources Representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" name="Complete management procedures (Human Resources Representative)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted" name="Management procedures completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Submit" sourceRef="StartEvent_VacationRequest" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Register" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Review" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ApproveOrReject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_ApproveOrReject" targetRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[requestRejected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome" targetRef="Task_GenerateNotification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[requestApproved]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_ReviewReasons" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewReasons_End" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectionReviewed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notification_Procedures" sourceRef="Task_GenerateNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_End" sourceRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
